Oneliner

Real-time monitoring of the cosmic radiation and space weather environment.
Description

Real-time monitoring of the cosmic radiation and space weather environment, and visualization of the measurement data for the industry and the public.

Results

ESA’s latest CubeSat – RadCube, for surveying space weather in low-Earth orbit – has completed its rigorous commissioning phase, culminating in the extension of a magnetometer boom longer than the miniature satellite itself.

In Flight Performance of the MAGIC MagnetoresistiveMagnetometer on the RadCube CubeSat, 2025.
